package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Grocery struct {
	ID        int       `json:"id"`
	Name      string    `json:"name"`
	Quantity  int       `json:"quantity"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

func CreateGrocery(db *sql.DB, name string, quantity int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		INSERT INTO groceries (name, quantity)
		VALUES ($1, $2)
		RETURNING id, created_at, updated_at
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, name, quantity).Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	grocery.Name = name
	grocery.Quantity = quantity
	return &grocery, nil
}

func GetGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at
		FROM groceries
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, id).Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.Name, &grocery.Quantity, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &grocery, nil
}

func ListGroceries(db *sql.DB) ([]*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at
		FROM groceries
	`
	rows, err := db.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var groceries []*Grocery
	for rows.Next() {
		var grocery Grocery
		err := rows.Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.Name, &grocery.Quantity, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		groceries = append(groceries, &grocery)
	}
	return groceries, nil
}

func UpdateGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int, name string, quantity int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		UPDATE groceries
		SET name = $1, quantity = $2, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
		WHERE id = $3
		RETURNING created_at, updated_at
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, name, quantity, id).Scan(&grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	grocery.ID = id
	grocery.Name = name
	grocery.Quantity = quantity
	return &grocery, nil
}

func DeleteGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	query := `
		DELETE FROM groceries
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	_, err := db.Exec(query, id)
	return err
}

	db, err := db.NewDB(os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"))

	}

	router.GET("/groceries", groceriesHandler.List)
	router.GET("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.GetByID)
	router.POST("/groceries", groceriesHandler.Create)
	router.PUT("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.UpdateByID)
	router.DELETE("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.DeleteByID)

	log.Printf("Starting server on :%s", port)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, router))
}
